verdict.rationale: Bolna's own Agent Studio documents turning a short use-case description into a call-ready voice agent with no prompt engineering, which covers the core of AI-assisted agent authoring. Evidence is a single first-party docs statement. missing for 10: AI improvement of existing prompts, AI-generated flows, AI-generated test cases, depth documentation of what Studio produces, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the platform's own AI helps me author agents — generating or improving prompts, flows, and test cases from a description

citations.quote: Agent Studio turns a short description of your use case into a production-grade, call-ready voice AI agent — in 5 to 8 minutes. No prompt engineering, no guesswork.
